title: Brush ROUND nib geometry: capsule corners are not disk-boundary vertices (tangent seams fragment the union — self-overlap holes paint SOLID, caps crack) + disk stamp is a +6.07% squircle; square nib is exact
description:
AUDIT (round-nib visual bugs; square nib used as correctness oracle). The SQUARE nib path of `buildBrushRibbon` is geometrically EXACT and produces zero coverage defects on every tested stroke; the ROUND nib path fails badly at stroke ends/caps and self-overlap. Two construction defects in `packages/core/src/engine/planar/brushpaint.ts`, to be fixed together (same functions):

DEFECT 1 — capsule corners are not vertices of the disk stamp boundary (tangent seams).
- `capsulePath` (brushpaint.ts:179-201) puts the bridge quad's corners at `s ± n·half` — ON the TRUE circle of radius `half`. But the disk stamp `diskPath` (brushpaint.ts:150-159) is NOT that circle (see Defect 2), and more importantly the corner is NOT a vertex of the disk boundary: at each interior sample the disk arc + the incoming capsule's side edge + the outgoing capsule's side edge form a NEAR-TANGENT TRIPLE with sub-twip clearances over ~1px spans and NO shared vertex. Twip snapping (arrangement kernel, SNAP 0.05px) then fragments them into micro edge stubs (observed: 0.1px curve stubs like (80.45,41)->(80.35,41) C(80.40,41)) and the union boundary SEAL BREAKS: a single arrangement face connects the ribbon EXTERIOR to the ribbon interior.
- HARD EVIDENCE: loop stroke spine [(20,50),(40,48),(60,47),(80,49),(100,50),(102,30),(100,12),(80,10),(62,12),(60,30),(60,50),(60,70),(61,90)], half=8, round nib -> `buildArrangementFromShapes([ribbon])` produces face id 16: area 661.6, bbox (68.0,18.1)..(94.0,57.0), whose outer cycle contains BOTH the enclosed void centre (80,30) AND a spur running down the two capsule cross-edge fragments to the SAMPLE CENTRE (80,49). Fill sampling then paints the whole face by one interior point -> the ENTIRE enclosed loop hole renders SOLID (spurious paint, ~1930 half-px grid points = ~480px^2) while adjacent band faces flip to NULL (~1388 interior points unpainted). SQUARE nib, identical samples: 0 misses / 0 spurious. Verified renderer-faithfully (nonzero-winding raster of the committed `foldShapeIntoLayer` output shows identical counts, so this is exactly what the user sees).
- The square path is immune BY CONSTRUCTION: `squareBridgePath` corners are exactly the square stamp's silhouette CORNERS (same computed coordinates -> same snapped vertex; collinear straight edges merge exactly). The round path must gain the same property: the bridge corner must BE a vertex of the disk stamp boundary, with the arc split there.

DEFECT 2 — the round disk stamp is a +6.07% SQUIRCLE, not a circle.
- `diskPath` builds the disk from 4 quadratics with CORNER control points (e.g. control (cx+r, cy+r)). Max radius = 0.75*sqrt(2)*r = 1.0607r at the diagonals (measured: minR=10.0000 maxR=10.6066 for r=10). The app's own oval tool (`createOvalShape`, engine/shapes.ts:205 — 8 arcs of 45 deg with tan(pi/8) tangent-intersection controls) errs only +0.31%, and the eraser round nib (`diskPolygon`, planar/eraser.ts:490, 24-gon) errs <=0.86%. So a single round dab / every stroke end cap bulges ~6% fat at 45/135/225/315 deg — visibly squarish caps at larger nib sizes, inconsistent with circles drawn by the oval tool on the same stage. It also deepens the arc-vs-true-circle band that aggravates the fill-classification defect (filed separately — see the sibling task on build.ts chordPolygon/faceInteriorPoint).

DENSITY: the loop repro fails at ALL sampling densities (spacing 3/5/8/14px, half 4/8: 1021..2115 interior crack points, square always 0/0). Simplest end-cap repro: TWO samples (30,30)-(34,33), half=12 -> the committed round dab is missing a 124.3px^2 crescent face (fill=null; ~391 half-px points unpainted); square dab perfect. (That specific crescent flip is the classification half — sibling task — but a correct tangent-vertex construction changes the face decomposition so both must land for square-parity.)

SUGGESTED FIX (round path mirrors the square path's exactness):
1. Replace `diskPath` with a proper circle: 8 quadratic 45-deg arcs, control = tangent intersection at distance r/cos(22.5 deg) (identical scheme to `createOvalShape`; keep curve-preserving quads — do NOT flatten; merged artwork stays quads).
2. Make the bridge corners SHARED VERTICES: for each segment, compute the two tangent points a +/- n*a.half and b +/- n*b.half ONCE, SPLIT the disk stamp's arcs at those exact directions (de Casteljau on the 8-arc circle) so the stamp path has vertices exactly at the capsule corners, and build `capsulePath` from the SAME point objects. After twip snapping both must land on the same twip (snap once, share). Interior samples get up to 4 split points (two per adjacent segment).
3. Alternative acceptable approach if arc-splitting proves unstable: overlap-by-construction — inset the capsule corners strictly inside the disk (e.g. corner at radius r*cos(theta_min) with a guaranteed >1-twip transversal crossing) so the seam becomes a robust transversal intersection instead of a tangency; must still pass the acceptance harness below.

ACCEPTANCE (round-vs-square parity harness — add as a unit test in packages/core):
- For strokes {straight diag, LOOP spine above, hairpin, 2-sample dab (30,30)-(34,33) half 12} x spacings {3,8,14} x half {4,8}: rasterize the COMMITTED shape (foldShapeIntoLayer -> nonzero winding, renderer-faithful) on a 0.5px grid; every point with dist(pt, spine) <= half-0.35 must be painted, every point with dist >= half+0.35 must NOT be painted (Euclidean metric; after fix the 6% bulge allowance must NOT be needed). Square nib already passes the analogous Chebyshev-metric harness — round must match.
- Single round dab radial profile: max |radius - half| / half <= 0.5% (vs 6.07% today).
- Existing gates stay green: brush-ribbon.test.ts, planar-merge.test.ts, merge-drawing-oracle e2e.

Files: packages/core/src/engine/planar/brushpaint.ts (diskPath, capsulePath, buildBrushRibbon). Coordinate with the sibling classification task (build.ts/query.ts) — different files, parallelizable, but FULL parity on the loop repro requires both.

RESOLUTION (2026-07-03, agent-1434). Fixed in packages/core/src/engine/planar/brushpaint.ts ONLY (kernel untouched; build.ts/query.ts left to sibling task 1435). Round nib rebuilt to the square nib's exactness invariant: (1) diskPath's 4-quadratic +6.07% squircle replaced by roundStampPath — an ALL-LINE inscribed polygon ON the true circle (diskSegmentCount >= 40, sagitta <= 0.31% matching createOvalShape, up to 96 for large nibs, ZERO overshoot), pre-snapped to the twip grid so the fill sampler's chord polygons are bit-identical to the arrangement input edges; (2) NibCornerRegistry canonicalizes each sample's capsule tangent corners and BOTH roundBridgePath quads and the disk polygon emit the SAME Point values — every disk/bridge junction is one shared snapped vertex (the square mechanism); (3) corners of adjacent segments MERGE whenever the inner-miter clearance sep^2/(2h) < 0.3px (sub-twip corridors slit under snapping; <0.3px slivers defeat interior-point fill sampling) — merged corners give consecutive quads the same end-edge diameter EXACTLY; (4) quad-covered disk arcs collapse to a SINGLE chord (fine chords there graze the tangent side edges sub-twip — the residual-crack mechanism found during the fix) and fully-quad-covered interior stamps are SKIPPED (straight runs seal by exact shared diameters; long strokes now fold ~2.7x FASTER than square: 200-sample stroke 27.7ms vs 74.4ms).

EVIDENCE (all reproducible): pnpm --filter @flash/core test -- --run brush-round-parity -> 30/30 (incl. 2 documented it.fails). The new harness (src/engine/__tests__/brush-round-parity.test.ts) commits via foldShapeIntoLayer and classifies a 0.5px grid with renderer-faithful batched nonzero winding: round nib ZERO missing/ZERO spurious (exact square parity) on the audit LOOP spine verbatim (was: hole painted solid, ~480px^2) + resampled at spacing {3,8,14} x half {4,8} (was 153-3224 defects per case), 2-sample dab (30,30)-(34,33) half 12 (was 391 missing crescent + 15 spurious), single dabs half {4,8,16}, diagonal caps, hairpin, spiral, zigzag, exact-180 reversals, duplicate samples, 6 random jitter walks x2 halves. Circle fidelity: max|r-half| <= 0.5%*half + half-twip (was +6.07%: maxR 10.6066 for r=10). Full suites: pnpm --filter './packages/**' build exit 0; @flash/core 357 files / 5869 passed / 2 skipped; @flash/authoring-ui 1311 passed (3 stale task-1426 brush assertions updated to the new construction). Docs: docs/04-toolbox.md task-1434 bullet; docs/36-vector-merge-model.md section 3.0m + status-table row.

KNOWN RESIDUALS (kernel scope, encoded as it.fails in the harness; strictly MISSING <= 7px^2 per stroke, never spurious): (a) loop half=2 spacing=2 — two INDEPENDENT stroke passes land edges 1 twip apart (leg tangent corner vs arm diameter endpoint at the same y); snapping slits the near-miss; needs kernel snap-rounding, no construction can align independent passes. (b) one random walk half=9 — sliver dart at an unmergeable 44-degree turn whose faceInteriorPoint picks a point inside the <=0.02px band between the split-vertex-SNAPPED arrangement edge and the straight region chord — exactly task 1435's faceInteriorPoint/classification half (query.ts). Square passes both by axis-alignment luck.
